feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: GOP to host unusual midterm convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs take effect
entry.summary: Republicans are aiming to get voters to turn out for the midterms with an unconventional convention. And, Canada's retaliatory tariffs on the U.S. went into effect at midnight.

entry.title: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
entry.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

entry.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
entry.summary: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

entry.title: 60 years later, 'Star Trek' continues to 'live long and prosper'
entry.summary: The television series, Star Trek, turns 60 on Tuesday. The original show aired for only three seasons, but it spawned prequels and sequels (on TV and in theaters) and still has a cult following.

entry.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
entry.summary: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

entry.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
entry.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

entry.title: King Charles III clarifies status of Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan
entry.summary: King Charles III has reiterated that Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, remain non-working members of the royal family following their return to the United Kingdom.

entry.title: Russia and North Korea open the first road across their shared border
entry.summary: Relations between Russia and North Korea have been flourishing, with North Korea supplying ammunition and troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine in return for economic and military assistance.

entry.title: As Nepal identifies those killed in the floods, questions grow over China's reporting
entry.summary: One week after the deadly floods, very little is known about China's dead or missing. China's control over media and digital censorship is in stark contrast to open reporting in Nepal.

entry.title: 5 dead after crash at Miami Airport. And, Germany's far-right wins state election
entry.summary: A cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport has left five people dead and several others injured. And, Germany's far-right AfD party achieves an electoral victory in a key state election.
